rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing something in money or financial terms.

example.traditional: 呢個計劃經濟上係可行嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ging1 zai3 soeng6 hai6 ho2 hang4 ge3

rows.note: Use this casual phrasing when focusing on a person's or household's money situation.

example.english: Our family is doing a bit better financially lately.
example.traditional: 我哋一家喺錢方面近排鬆動咗啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 hai2 cin2 fong1 min6 gan6 paai2 sung1 dung6 zo2 di1

rows.note: Use this more formal wording for budgets, public finances, or an organization's financial management.

example.english: The government may not be able to afford this project financially.
example.traditional: 政府財政上未必負擔得起呢項工程。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 coi4 zing3 soeng6 mei6 bit1 fu6 daam1 dak1 hei2 ne1 hong6 gung1 cing4
